tasks.short: Interview experts and research instructional content

steps.what: Interview subject-matter experts and collect selected research sources and notes
Organise research claims and source passages into an instructional evidence outline

loop.purpose: Organise source-supported claims for the content brief
loop.output: Draft outline with claim-level passage links and disagreement labels
loop.check: Coordinator compares each claim with its full source passage and checks omitted qualifications and conflicting expert views
loop.stop: One draft and one correction pass; unsupported claims or conflicting meanings return to manual outlining
loop.why_not_simpler: Search can find terms but cannot reliably group differently worded claims without losing qualifications

steps.what: Verify evidence and decide which findings should inform instructional content

tasks.design: Use {DOCS} retrieval to organise an explicitly selected source set, with a bounded model drafting a passage-linked outline where search alone is insufficient. Keep expert interviews, source selection and final educational interpretation with the coordinator.
tasks.previous_blocker: Notes and sources must be compared across long documents before outlining.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-linked drafting can propose an outline while leaving the underlying passages visible.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting expert accounts and weak research require critical appraisal.
tasks.human_edge: Ask follow-up questions and judge whether evidence applies to the learners.
tasks.altitude: Less evidence organisation, without reducing expert contact or changing content authority.

evidence.claim: Passage-linked evidence outlining and the proposed time saving are an E1 design; no matching measured interview or research case is supplied.

assumptions: Boundary covers coordinator interviews, selected-source research and evidence outlining, excluding later full course writing.

Coordinator produces source identifier, title, version, passage location and expert-note provenance in s1; all capture and source selection remain within its 55 full hours. No free transcript or pre-tagged claim set is assumed.
Missing passage links or unreadable material require manual outlining within retained s2 time. No unsupported quote may enter the verified outline.
Test native search and document organisation before adding a bounded model. Four focal upkeep hours cover source access and checking the outline workflow.
unknowns: Source access rights and interview-note permissions
Actual outline effort and source quality
research_questions: Can outlining effort fall 40% after checking every claim and preserving disagreement?

already_counted.description: Interview, research selection and provenance capture
Claim-level review and manual outlining fallback

incremental.description: Maintain retrieval access and outline checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=88, gross=12 minus 4 upkeep gives net=8. High assumes source-linked outline reuse; low assumes only 4 hours saved after review. Interview 55 and interpretation 15 remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Present recommendations on course design, technology and delivery

steps.what: Compare course design, technology and delivery options against instructional requirements
Draft presentation explaining selected recommendation and trade-offs

loop.purpose: Turn the coordinator's chosen rationale into a clear presentation
loop.input: Selected rationale and cited option evidence
loop.output: Draft slides with trade-offs and source links
loop.check: Coordinator verifies that slides preserve the selected option, caveats, costs and alternatives without adding claims
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unsupported comparisons or changed recommendations return to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates handle layout but cannot phrase varied explanatory material

steps.what: Approve presentation and present recommendations, answering educators' questions

tasks.design: Use a native presentation template in {DOCS} and a bounded drafting step for the coordinator's selected rationale. Keep option choice, final slide approval and discussion with educators human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Explanatory slides are rewritten from an already chosen recommendation.
tasks.enabler_now: Text rewriting can help express the rationale without selecting the recommendation.
tasks.still_hard: Feasibility and educational trade-offs require context and discussion.
tasks.human_edge: Defend the recommendation and revise it when educators identify a valid constraint.
tasks.altitude: Less slide drafting; recommendation and presentation responsibility stays the same.

evidence.claim: LessonUp can rewrite slide text by tone or level; this supports text assistance, not automated course-design recommendations.
The presentation workflow and 15-hour gross saving are E1 design assumptions.

assumptions: Boundary is comparing options and presenting a selected recommendation, not implementing a course or procuring technology.

Coordinator produces selected option, reasons, alternatives, constraints, cost references and source links in s1 with all capture retained. The model receives this rationale rather than an assumed structured recommendation.
Missing costs or unsupported benefits remain explicit unknowns; manual drafting occurs within retained s2 time.
Try native templates and rewriting before custom work. Three focal upkeep hours cover approved templates and drafting controls.
unknowns: Audience, source completeness and native rewriting support
research_questions: Can drafting halve while preserving every caveat and leaving discussion duration unchanged?

already_counted.description: Draft meaning review and manual rewriting fallback

incremental.description: Maintain approved presentation template and drafting controls

approvals.approved_version: Final slide version including selected option, claims, caveats, cost figures, source links and audience; changes void approval before presentation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=85, gross=15 minus 3 upkeep gives net=12. High assumes reusable rationale and editable drafts; low assumes only 3 drafting hours saved. Comparison 35 and presentation 35 remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide analytical support for curricula and courseware standards

steps.what: Define analytical question and verify relevant curriculum, assessment and resource data
Assemble descriptive tables comparing training coverage, results and resources
Interpret findings and provide analytical support for curricula, strategies, policies or standards

tasks.design: Configure descriptive exports in {LMS} and reusable checked tables in {SPREADSHEET}. Keep analytical framing, educational interpretation and policy or standards advice with the coordinator; do not infer causal instructional effectiveness from descriptive totals.
tasks.previous_blocker: Comparable descriptive tables are rebuilt from existing exports.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reporting and saved transformations can repeat a defined calculation.
tasks.still_hard: Missing cohorts and inconsistent measures can make apparent comparisons misleading.
tasks.human_edge: Explain limitations and connect findings to realistic design choices.
tasks.altitude: Less table assembly, with unchanged responsibility for interpreting educational evidence.

evidence.claim: Ans supports item analysis and closed-question grading; this supports assessment-data preparation, not automated curriculum or policy judgement.
Reusable descriptive tables and the proposed assembly saving are E1 design assumptions.

assumptions: Boundary is analytical support for design and standards, excluding recommendation presentation and downstream implementation. No individual learner scoring is introduced.

Existing assessment staff produce assessment identifier, cohort, period, score and denominator; curriculum authors maintain module and objective references; resource owners maintain hours and costs in their unchanged records. Coordinator selects measures, checks definitions and records analysis filters in s1 with full capture counted.

Retained s2 time includes reconciliation, missing-data handling and manual table preparation when definitions or mappings fail. No free standardised objective mapping is assumed; new tagging work requires re-estimation.
Test native reporting and saved spreadsheet queries first. Four focal upkeep hours cover definition, mapping and access checks.
unknowns: Comparable measures, data completeness and permissions
research_questions: Can reusable tables halve assembly while reconciling denominators and exposing missing cohorts?

already_counted.description: Framing and verification of analysis inputs

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=82.5, gross=17.5 minus 4 upkeep gives net=13.5. High requires comparable existing records; low assumes only 4 assembly hours removable. All 65 framing and interpretation hours remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recommend curricula or delivery changes from evidence and constraints

steps.what: Gather current effectiveness findings, performance requirements, feasibility evidence and costs
Evaluate trade-offs and decide whether curricula or delivery methods should change
Explain recommended changes, limitations and proposed evaluation to decision makers

tasks.design: Use a source-linked view in {DOCS} to gather existing analysis and constraint records for a specific change question. Keep the recommendation, trade-offs and explanation with the coordinator; the view neither creates missing evidence nor decides what should change.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current versions of existing findings and constraints are gathered repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native links and version metadata can reduce collection time.
tasks.still_hard: Evidence can conflict and future performance requirements may be uncertain.
tasks.human_edge: Recommend proportionate changes and explain what would disconfirm the recommendation.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less evidence collection, with the same recommendation authority.

reach.learn: Practical feasibility and meaningful evaluation criteria

evidence.claim: A source-linked change-evidence pack and its saving are an E1 design, not a documented automated curriculum recommendation.

assumptions: Boundary starts with existing analysis and constraints and ends with a change recommendation; producing assessment analysis is owned by the separate analytical-support task and earns no duplicate saving here.

Existing analysts produce dated effectiveness findings with methods and limitations; requirement owners and resource owners produce requirements and cost records. Coordinator selects source identifier, version and relevance to the change question in retained s1 time, including manual collection where metadata is missing.
No structured effectiveness score or feasibility flag is assumed. Gaps remain explicit and recommendation work stays manual.
Use native linked views before custom code. Two focal upkeep hours cover source-link and access maintenance; no separate presentation-slide drafting is included here.
unknowns: Currency and completeness of existing analyses and constraints
research_questions: Can source linking reduce collection by 40% while retaining all uncertainty checks?

already_counted.description: Source selection, version checks and manual collection

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=92, gross=8 minus 2 upkeep gives net=6. High assumes reusable evidence links; low assumes only 2 collection hours saved. Recommendation and explanation retain 80 hours; upstream analysis is not counted again.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Evidence organisation, table assembly and drafting shrink while expert dialogue and educational judgement remain central.
role.ambitious_version: Give educators well-supported options and explain their limits without handing curriculum judgement to a model.
